DRIFT FOUND: which conversation the U-protocol 'two new messages' land in. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:39 says 'On Tomas's conversation from T [the new J2 card's conversation]: ... Tomas sends two messages; read Rafael's count on that conversation and his total ... Read Mei Lin's count for the same conversation.' tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:335 (hro_unread_counts) says 'Mei Lin starts with 2 unread on Tomas Varga's Data Analyst conversation; after Tomas's two new messages Rafael's count for that conversation rises by exactly two ... Mei Lin's count for the same conversation is her own.' In the criterion the antecedent of 'that conversation'/'the same conversation' is the seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201), whereas the protocol places the messages in the T conversation. Additional risk (P3, not a file drift): the seeded 'Mei Lin starts with 2' literal is mutable shared state; polish hro_pol_failed_send ('in a conversation', any) and hro_pol_session_resume (Mei opens 'that conversation') could alter Mei's APP-201 count if polish runs before functional and the judge picks APP-201; scored-suite dimension order was not measured. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: scripted golden only), so the misgrade below is NOT EXERCISED.
counterexample: A conforming app: Tomas sends two messages in the T conversation (as prompt.md:39 instructs). Rafael's count on that conversation goes 0->2 and his total +2, correct. A judge reading hro_unread_counts literally checks Rafael's count on the Data Analyst conversation (APP-201), which stays at its starting 3 (no Rafael read marker in seed), concludes it did not 'rise by exactly two', and scores the weight-2 row 0. Conversely, a broken app that counts unread globally per conversation rather than per person could pass the Mei leg under one reading and not the other, so the row's outcome depends on which referent the judge picks rather than on the submission.
suggested_fix: Rewrite hro_unread_counts to name one referent, e.g. 'Mei Lin starts with 2 unread on Tomas Varga's Data Analyst conversation. After Tomas's two new messages in his conversation from T, Rafael's count for that T conversation rises by exactly two and his total by two; opening it clears it; Mei Lin's count for the T conversation is her own', and optionally have polish avoid the seeded Data Analyst conversation.
